mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.bbs_id, p.content_html, p.content_text, p.category_code, p.author_id, p.author_name, p.is_notice, p.notice_from, p.notice_until, p.is_secret, p.view_count, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.attachment_count, p.status, p.published_at, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.deleted_at, COALESCE(i18n.title, p.title) AS title, CASE WHEN i18n.title IS NOT NULL THEN #{lang} ELSE 'ko' END AS language FROM bbs_post p LEFT JOIN bbs_post_i18n i18n ON i18n.post_id = p.id AND i18n.language = #{lang} AND #{lang} != 'ko' WHERE p.bbs_id = #{bbsMasterId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.is_notice DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id, bbs_id, title, content_html, content_text, category_code, author_id, author_name, is_notice, notice_from, notice_until, is_secret, view_count, like_count, comment_count, attachment_count, status, published_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM bbs_post WHERE bbs_id = #{bbsMasterId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND search_vector @@ plainto_tsquery('simple', #{keyword}) ORDER BY ts_rank(search_vector, plainto_tsquery('simple', #{keyword})) DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bbs_post WHERE bbs_id = #{bbsMasterId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bbs_post WHERE bbs_id = #{bbsMasterId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND search_vector @@ plainto_tsquery('simple', #{keyword})

SELECT id, bbs_id, title, content_html, content_text, category_code, author_id, author_name, is_notice, notice_from, notice_until, is_secret, view_count, like_count, comment_count, attachment_count, status, published_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM bbs_post WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bbs_post (bbs_id, title, content_html, content_text, author_id, author_name, is_notice, notice_from, notice_until, is_secret, status) VALUES (#{bbsId}, #{title}, #{contentHtml}, #{contentText}, #{authorId}, #{authorName}, #{notice}, #{noticeFrom}, #{noticeUntil}, #{secret}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE bbs_post SET title = #{title}, content_html = #{contentHtml}, content_text = #{contentText}, is_notice = #{notice}, notice_from = #{noticeFrom}, notice_until = #{noticeUntil}, is_secret = #{secret}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE bbs_post SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE bbs_post SET deleted_at = NOW(), status = 'DELETED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE bbs_post SET status = 'SCHEDULED', scheduled_at = #{scheduledAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE bbs_post SET status = 'DRAFT', scheduled_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE bbs_post SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = NOW(), scheduled_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SCHEDULED' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, bbs_id, title, content_html, content_text, category_code, author_id, author_name, is_notice, notice_from, notice_until, is_secret, view_count, like_count, comment_count, attachment_count, status, published_at, scheduled_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM bbs_post WHERE status = 'SCHEDULED' AND scheduled_at <= NOW() AND deleted_at IS NULL
